 Vermont’s minimum wage will rise from $14.42 to $14.91 an hour on Jan. 1, 2027, the Vermont Department of Labor announced Monday.
 Though a 49-cent hourly increase could seem marginal, it amounts to about $1,000 more a year for someone who works 40 hours a week.
